name: Kilobat CLI
description: Diagnose failed host and API connections on a Mac through a CLI or local MCP server, with JSON results for coding agents.
longDescription: GPL-3.0-only CLI for macOS 14+. Inspect DNS, connection failures, Wi-Fi, latency and traffic from the local Mac. Homebrew builds from source and requires Xcode 16+. Some per-network data and Wi-Fi names depend on permissions and the separate proprietary desktop app. Some commands change settings; clients control permission prompts.

skills.name: Diagnose host connections
skills.description: Inspect connection layers for a failing host or API on the local Mac and return structured results for troubleshooting.

skills.name: Inspect network status
skills.description: Read local traffic, Wi-Fi, latency and DNS information to help explain the connection available to a coding agent.
